The chest X-ray shows fine reticular granularity and a ground-glass appearance, which is highly characteristic of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) in a premature infant. Given the baby was born at 33 weeks, this aligns perfectly with surfactant deficiency.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to surfactant deficiency in a preterm infant.
